subject.title: fix: Microsoft Teams streaming keeps chunk after whitespace collapse

question: Should this maintainer-labeled PR wait for live Microsoft Teams proof, or is focused controller proof enough for this narrow SDK-boundary bug fix?
rationale: The patch is code-correct from source and SDK inspection, but the contributor-provided proof is only a focused Vitest run while the changed behavior is visible in Microsoft Teams streaming output.

options.title: Require live Teams proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted Teams transcript, recording, or runtime log that shows the second chunk remains intact after a collapsed-whitespace boundary before merge.

options.title: Accept focused controller proof
options.body: A maintainer may choose to accept the source-level reproduction plus SDK-contract proof and focused regression test for this narrow controller-only path.

recommendation.title: Require live Teams proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted Teams transcript, recording, or runtime log that shows the second chunk remains intact after a collapsed-whitespace boundary before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Most recent high-confidence owner signal from merging and maintaining the Teams SDK streaming migration path.
